variables.name: Servicio
Canal

0.content:
## Nexus - General (métricas de ingesta)
Métricas `custom.nexus.log.*` extraídas en OpenPipeline: cuestan lo mismo con cualquier rango y volumen, pero solo tienen datos desde que se creó cada una. Cluster: uno, varios o `*`. Servicio y Canal filtran respuestas, errores de mapeo y timeouts del adaptador; Servicio también errores y pasos del mngr. El detalle (rquid, ejemplos, mensajes) está en el tablero de detalle.

2.title: Respuestas adaptador
2.query:
timeseries r = sum(custom.nexus.log.adapter.responses), by: { nexus.cluster, nexus.service, nexus.channel, nexus.outcome }
| filter (in("*", $Cluster) or in(nexus.cluster, $Cluster)) and ($Servicio == "*" or nexus.service == $Servicio) and (in("*", $Canal) or in(nexus.channel, $Canal))
| fieldsAdd n = arraySum(r)
| summarize responses = sum(n)

3.title: % OK (2xx)
3.query:
timeseries r = sum(custom.nexus.log.adapter.responses), by: { nexus.cluster, nexus.service, nexus.channel, nexus.outcome }
| filter (in("*", $Cluster) or in(nexus.cluster, $Cluster)) and ($Servicio == "*" or nexus.service == $Servicio) and (in("*", $Canal) or in(nexus.channel, $Canal))
| fieldsAdd n = arraySum(r)
| summarize total = sum(n), x = sum(if(nexus.outcome == "ok_2xx", n, else: 0))
| fields pct_ok = round(100.0 * x / total, decimals: 2)

4.title: % 412 (negocio)
4.query:
timeseries r = sum(custom.nexus.log.adapter.responses), by: { nexus.cluster, nexus.service, nexus.channel, nexus.outcome }
| filter (in("*", $Cluster) or in(nexus.cluster, $Cluster)) and ($Servicio == "*" or nexus.service == $Servicio) and (in("*", $Canal) or in(nexus.channel, $Canal))
| fieldsAdd n = arraySum(r)
| summarize total = sum(n), x = sum(if(nexus.outcome == "business_412", n, else: 0))
| fields pct_412 = round(100.0 * x / total, decimals: 2)

5.title: % error
5.query:
timeseries r = sum(custom.nexus.log.adapter.responses), by: { nexus.cluster, nexus.service, nexus.channel, nexus.outcome }
| filter (in("*", $Cluster) or in(nexus.cluster, $Cluster)) and ($Servicio == "*" or nexus.service == $Servicio) and (in("*", $Canal) or in(nexus.channel, $Canal))
| fieldsAdd n = arraySum(r)
| summarize total = sum(n), x = sum(if(nexus.outcome == "error", n, else: 0))
| fields pct_error = round(100.0 * x / total, decimals: 2)

6.title: Timeouts 504
6.query:
timeseries t = sum(custom.nexus.log.adapter.timeouts), by: { nexus.cluster, nexus.service, nexus.channel }
| filter (in("*", $Cluster) or in(nexus.cluster, $Cluster)) and ($Servicio == "*" or nexus.service == $Servicio) and (in("*", $Canal) or in(nexus.channel, $Canal))
| fieldsAdd n = arraySum(t)
| summarize timeouts = sum(n)

7.title: % rechazo al canal (M)
7.query:
timeseries s = sum(custom.nexus.log.mngr.soap_responses), by: { nexus.cluster, nexus.acceptance, nexus.soap.operation, nexus.soap.msg_code }
| filter (in("*", $Cluster) or in(nexus.cluster, $Cluster))
| fieldsAdd n = arraySum(s)
| summarize total = sum(n), m = sum(if(nexus.acceptance == "M", n, else: 0))
| fields pct_m = round(100.0 * m / total, decimals: 2)

8.title: RESPUESTAS ADAPTADOR EN EL TIEMPO
8.description: ok_2xx y business_412 no son error

9.title: ERRORES ADAPTADOR POR CLUSTER

10.title: % ERROR POR CLUSTER
10.query:
timeseries r = sum(custom.nexus.log.adapter.responses), by: { nexus.cluster, nexus.service, nexus.channel, nexus.outcome }
| filter (in("*", $Cluster) or in(nexus.cluster, $Cluster)) and ($Servicio == "*" or nexus.service == $Servicio) and (in("*", $Canal) or in(nexus.channel, $Canal))
| fieldsAdd n = arraySum(r)
| summarize total = sum(n), errors = sum(if(nexus.outcome == "error", n, else: 0)),
    business_412 = sum(if(nexus.outcome == "business_412", n, else: 0)),
    unknown = sum(if(nexus.outcome == "unknown", n, else: 0)), by: { nexus.cluster }
| fieldsAdd pct_error = round(100.0 * errors / total, decimals: 2)
| sort pct_error desc

11.title: RESPUESTAS POR SERVICIO Y CANAL
11.query:
timeseries r = sum(custom.nexus.log.adapter.responses), by: { nexus.cluster, nexus.service, nexus.channel, nexus.outcome }
| filter (in("*", $Cluster) or in(nexus.cluster, $Cluster)) and ($Servicio == "*" or nexus.service == $Servicio) and (in("*", $Canal) or in(nexus.channel, $Canal))
| fieldsAdd n = arraySum(r)
| summarize total = sum(n), errors = sum(if(nexus.outcome == "error", n, else: 0)),
    business_412 = sum(if(nexus.outcome == "business_412", n, else: 0)),
    by: { nexus.cluster, nexus.service, nexus.channel }
| fieldsAdd pct_error = round(100.0 * errors / total, decimals: 2)
| sort errors desc, total desc
| limit 50

13.title: ERRORES DE MAPEO POR SERVICIO Y CAMPO

14.title: TIMEOUTS 504 POR CLUSTER

15.title: TIMEOUTS 504 POR SERVICIO Y CANAL

16.description: Stratus contestó después de que el adaptador cortó. Un 504 sin respuesta tardía = Stratus no contestó

17.title: LATENCIA BACKEND POR ADAPTADOR (promedio ms)

18.description: Reemplazo del p95: % de llamadas que tardan más de 1 s y de 5 s

21.title: RESPUESTAS AL CANAL EN EL TIEMPO (B / M / C)
21.description: C (corregido) va aparte hasta que negocio defina si es éxito o falla

22.title: ERRORES DEL MNGR POR CLUSTER

23.title: RESPUESTAS AL CANAL POR CLUSTER
23.query:
timeseries s = sum(custom.nexus.log.mngr.soap_responses), by: { nexus.cluster, nexus.acceptance, nexus.soap.operation, nexus.soap.msg_code }
| filter (in("*", $Cluster) or in(nexus.cluster, $Cluster))
| fieldsAdd n = arraySum(s)
| summarize total = sum(n), b = sum(if(nexus.acceptance == "B", n, else: 0)),
    m = sum(if(nexus.acceptance == "M", n, else: 0)), c = sum(if(nexus.acceptance == "C", n, else: 0)),
    by: { nexus.cluster }
| fieldsAdd pct_b = round(100.0 * b / total, decimals: 2), pct_m = round(100.0 * m / total, decimals: 2),
            pct_c = round(100.0 * c / total, decimals: 2)
| sort pct_m desc

24.title: OPERACIONES CON MÁS RESPUESTAS M
24.query:
timeseries s = sum(custom.nexus.log.mngr.soap_responses), by: { nexus.cluster, nexus.acceptance, nexus.soap.operation, nexus.soap.msg_code }
| filter (in("*", $Cluster) or in(nexus.cluster, $Cluster))
| fieldsAdd n = arraySum(s)
| summarize total = sum(n), m = sum(if(nexus.acceptance == "M", n, else: 0)),
    by: { nexus.cluster, nexus.soap.operation, nexus.soap.msg_code }
| filter m > 0
| fieldsAdd pct_m = round(100.0 * m / total, decimals: 2)
| sort m desc
| limit 30

25.title: ERRORES DEL MNGR POR SERVICIO
25.query:
timeseries e = sum(custom.nexus.log.mngr.errors), by: { nexus.cluster, nexus.service }
| filter (in("*", $Cluster) or in(nexus.cluster, $Cluster)) and ($Servicio == "*" or nexus.service == $Servicio)
| fieldsAdd errors = arraySum(e)
| fields nexus.cluster, nexus.service, errors
| filter errors > 0
| sort errors desc
| limit 30

26.title: CONSUMIDOR QUE NO COINCIDE (por 100 tx)
26.query:
timeseries mm = sum(custom.nexus.log.mngr.consumer_mismatch), tx = sum(custom.nexus.log.adapter.responses), by: { nexus.cluster }
| filter (in("*", $Cluster) or in(nexus.cluster, $Cluster))
| fieldsAdd mismatches = arraySum(mm), transactions = arraySum(tx)
| fieldsAdd per_100_tx = round(100.0 * mismatches / transactions, decimals: 1)
| fields nexus.cluster, mismatches, transactions, per_100_tx
| sort per_100_tx desc

27.title: PASOS DEL ESB MÁS LENTOS
27.query:
timeseries avg_ms = avg(custom.nexus.log.esb.step_ms), max_ms = max(custom.nexus.log.esb.step_ms), by: { nexus.cluster, nexus.service, nexus.esb.step }
| filter (in("*", $Cluster) or in(nexus.cluster, $Cluster)) and ($Servicio == "*" or nexus.service == $Servicio)
| fieldsAdd avg_ms = round(arrayAvg(avg_ms), decimals: 1), max_ms = arrayMax(max_ms)
| fields nexus.cluster, nexus.service, nexus.esb.step, avg_ms, max_ms
| sort avg_ms desc
| limit 30
27.description: avg_ms es el promedio de los promedios por intervalo

29.title: LÍNEAS DE LOG POR NIVEL
29.description: Sin los errores de apagado del adaptador

30.title: WARN Y ERROR POR COMPONENTE
30.query:
timeseries l = sum(custom.nexus.log.log_lines), by: { nexus.cluster, nexus.component, loglevel }
| filter (in("*", $Cluster) or in(nexus.cluster, $Cluster)) and in(loglevel, array("ERROR", "WARN"))
| fieldsAdd lines = arraySum(l)
| fields nexus.component, loglevel, lines
| sort lines desc
| limit 30
